execution.ref: CHALLENGE-AI-COOLING-09 final Black check single-worker attempt
execution.description: Repeated Black --check with one worker after the default-worker invocation stalled.

expected: A single worker would avoid the host multiprocessing stall and return the formatting verdict.
observed: The single-worker command also produced no output or completion for 30 seconds and was terminated; its two orphaned launcher processes were then stopped by exact PID. No formatting verdict was claimed.
keep: Terminate only the exact tool processes launched by this ticket when a bounded host check stalls.
change: Use Black's Python API in-process for the final host check and rely on canonical CI for authoritative quality acceptance.
